At the ~33 km ceiling this lands near 20 km (~20.05 km at a 600 px-tall panel), matching what the owner was told and agreed to. Houses stop instancing at map3d_house_view_m (9000); picking (Map3DContext.pick_reach_px) still never depends on the dot being drawn.
